title: Rejection probability after local composition
statement: Let $n\ge1$, let $V$ be a finite-seed nonadaptive verifier with Boolean input and proof, input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and $r$ query positions, and let $K>0$. Suppose a reduction assigns to each verifier seed a CNF formula on $r+K$ sign variables with exactly $K$ nonempty clauses of width at most three; for every transcript, the formula is satisfiable by an auxiliary sign assignment exactly when the verifier accepts that transcript. Let $w$ be a Boolean input word, let $p$ be a Boolean proof word of length $\ell+K|\mathrm{Seed}(V)|$, and suppose the verifier rejects the word formed from $w$ and the first $\ell$ proof bits at some seed. Then, fixing that seed and choosing one of its $K$ clauses uniformly, the expected rejection indicator of the composed three-query verifier is at least $1/K$.
hypotheses_covered: A PCPP verifier with finite seed set, input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and $r$ query positions
Positive integer clause count $K$ and a seedwise reduction satisfying the stated clause, completeness, and soundness conditions
A verifier seed at which the restricted outer proof is rejected
